The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nevoota (planet)|Nevoota]] was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the eponymous '''Nevoota''', an [[Insectoid/Legends|insectoid]], [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. The Nevoota species was disdainful of [[Death/Legends|death]] and was considered one of the deadliest species in the known [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]. The Nevoota were [[Nevoota Extinction|invaded]] by the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] prior to the [[Old Sith Wars]], and over the course of a three-[[Standard year/Legends|year]] war, the species was hunted to [[Speciecide|extinction]]. The experience proved formative for Mandalorian culture, which [[Deity/Legends|deified]] war.

==Biology and appearance==
The Nevoota were a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]]<ref name="History" /> of [[Vespid/Legends|vespid]]<ref name="Skye" /> who had no fear of [[Death/Legends|death]].<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|type=codex|The Nevoota Extinction}}</ref>

==History==
The Nevoota were native to [[Nevoota (planet)|Nevoota]],<ref name="History" /> a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Warfare">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> located in the [[Balmorra system/Legends|Balmorra system]]<ref name="Codex" /> of the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies Regions]].<ref name="Atlas">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> Prior to the [[Old Sith Wars]], the Nevoota were considered by some to be one of the deadliest species in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="Codex" />

[[File:BusyLittleBee-CW02.png|thumb|right|300px|The Republic fielded a assault ship called the ''Nevoota Bee''.]]
In [[4024 BBY]],<ref name="Warfare" /> that reputation attracted the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] warrior culture, which [[Nevoota Extinction|invaded]] Nevoota in order to test the [[Mandalorian Crusaders]] corps against a potent foe. The Nevoota were led by a cunning warlord named [[Ithcharaka]]. Vastly outnumbering the Mandalorians, and with a disdain for death, the Nevoota resisted the Mandalorians for three [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of war, before they were eventually hunted to [[Speciecide|extinction]] by the warrior culture in [[4021 BBY]].<ref name="Codex" /> The hostilities proved epochal for the Mandalorians, as it led to the [[Deity/Legends|deification]] of war in their culture.<ref name="History" />

In the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], of [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], a [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|''Acclamator''-class assault ship]] named the ''[[Nevoota Bee/Legends|Nevoota Bee]]'' served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and fought in the [[Battle of Muunilinst/Legends|Battle of Muunilinst]].<ref name="Warfare" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Nevoota species was first [[canon]]ized by [[Abel G. Peña]] in his article [[The History of the Mandalorians: Exploring the Evolution of a Mighty Race of Warriors|''The History of the Mandalorians'']], which was published in [[Star Wars Insider 80|''Star Wars Insider'' 80]]<ref name="History" /> in [[January]] [[2005]].<ref name="Insider 80 Date">{{SWArchive|url=community/fanclub/mag/news20050110.html|text=Clone Wars Continue in ''Insider'' #80}}</ref> The name Nevoota had previously been introduced to ''[[Star Wars]]'' canon by [[Daniel Wallace]] in creating the Nevoota [[Star system/Legends|system]] for ''[[The Essential Guide to Planets and Moons]]'', published in [[1998]]. Wallace placed [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] in this system, and subsequent sources have renamed it as the Balmorra system.<ref name="Atlas" />

===The "Nevoota Bee" joke===
{{Quote|It never ceases to bring a smile to my face&mdash;what started as a sarcastic comment from Tom, an April Fools' Day joke from me, and an in-joke from Mike has actually evolved into a long-lost chapter of Star Wars lore.|Rich Handley|<ref name="ShavenWookiee">{{WebCite|url=http://www.shavenwookie.com/orhp/humour/palbacca.txt|text=Palbacca and the Neevoota Bees|author=[[Rich Handley]]|date=1999-10-27|work=www.shavenwookie.com|archivedate=20080331054009}}</ref>}}
Abel Peña explained on the [[Jedi Council Forums]] that his mention of the Nevoota was a nod to the long-running "Nevoota Bee" joke.<ref name="JCF1">{{JCFCite|url=posts/18101153|board=Literature|thread=Insider #80 to feature Mandalorian article, Yo Joe!|user=[[Abel G. Peña|Halagad_Ventor]]|date=2005-01-18|time=11:32 PM}}</ref> The origin of this joke is that [[Tom Veitch]], author of several ''Star Wars'' [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] series, was once asked, "What is that buzzing noise in the background of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''A New Hope'']]?," to which he replied, "The Nevoota Bee"&mdash;in reality, the noise was likely caused by a bad copy of the film. Unconnected to that discussion, [[Rich Handley]], author of several ''Star Wars'' articles, made an April Fools' joke on rec.arts.sf.starwars.misc, announcing a sequel to Veitch's ''[[Star Wars: Empire's End]]'' comic series involving Emperor Palpatine being reborn in an insane [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] of [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], named Palbacca.<ref name="JCF2">{{JCFCite|url=posts/18104880|board=Literature|thread=Insider #80 to feature Mandalorian article, Yo Joe!|user=[[Abel G. Peña|Halagad_Ventor]]|date=2005-01-19|time=11:38 AM}}</ref><ref name="ShavenWookiee" />

The final step in the joke occurred when [[Mike Beidler]], author of the ''[http://webspace.webring.com/people/vm/mikebeidler/starwarsliteraturecompendium/nr3empire.html Star Wars Literature Compendium]'' fansite, combined Veitch's and Handley's quips and listed the "Scourge of the Nevoota Bee" trilogy as a publication on his website. The fictitious trilogy of novels and accompanying fifty-part comic series was purported to be written by Veitch and Beidler, with audiobook adaptations read by Handley. The joke has since continued to circulate among the Star Wars online fan community.<ref name="JCF2" /><ref name="ShavenWookiee" />
